datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Burkina Faso administrative units. The classifications represent food insecurity phases (IPC scenarios) for near-term projections, aggregated geographically and temporally to produce monthly snapshots of acute food insecurity impact.
